item.text: {"search_note":"I found strong evidence of progress on the economy, chips, AI safety, border enforcement, and alliance management. I did not find equally strong evidence that Biden’s political/durability program improved by year-end; that lane moved sharply the other way after the debate collapse. So the cleanest reading is: closer on policy and influence, farther from durable political control.","evidence":[{"title":"Joint Statement of Janet L. Yellen and Shalanda D. VP Harris gets his nod","publisher":"Associated Press","date":"2024-07-21","url":"https://www.ap.org/news-highlights/elections/2024/biden-drops-out-of-2024-race-after-disastrous-debate-inflamed-age-concerns-vp-harris-gets-his-nod/","summary":"The campaign collapse forced Biden out of the race, showing that the political power/durability side of the program ended the year worse than it began.","question_ids":["8B.10","8B.8","8B.9","8B.7"]},{"title":"The final days: How Biden and his inner circle blew it","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-07-21","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/the-final-days-how-biden-and-his-inner-circle-blew-it-3528027","summary":"Reuters describes strategic missteps and internal dysfunction that deepened doubts about Biden’s ability to carry his second-term program forward.","question_ids":["8B.10","8B.8","8B.9","8B.7"]},{"title":"Federal judge temporarily blocks Biden’s student debt relief plan","publisher":"The Washington Post","date":"2024-09-05","url":"https://www.washingtonpost.com/education/2024/09/05/federal-court-blocks-biden-student-loan-forgiveness-plan/","summary":"A flagship affordability initiative was blocked again by court order, so at least one major revealed goal did not survive legal resistance by year-end.","question_ids":["8B.10","8B.8","8B.7"]},{"title":"US tracking nearly 500 incidents of civilian harm during Gaza war","publisher":"Reuters via The Guardian","date":"2024-10-30","url":"https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/oct/30/civilian-harm-us-weapons-israel-gaza-war","summary":"Officials tracked hundreds of harm incidents involving U.S.-furnished weapons but took no further action on any of them, showing weak leverage use and incomplete movement toward the stated restraint/protection posture.","question_ids":["8B.10","8B.9","8B.7","8B.6"]}]}
